title: Money as a record
description:
Represent money safely with a record.

```
10.00 GBP + 5.50 GBP = 15.50 GBP
Cannot add GBP and EUR
Split 10.00 GBP three ways: 3.34, 3.33, 3.33
```
hints: Work in pennies: `long pennies = (long)(Amount * 100);`, `each = pennies / parts`, and the first `pennies % parts` parts get one more.
Records compare by value, so `new Money(1m, "GBP") == new Money(1m, "GBP")` is true (lesson 3.02).
requirements: `record Money(decimal Amount, string Currency)` with an `Add` method that throws `InvalidOperationException` for different currencies.
`Split(int parts)` returns parts that add up exactly to the original (the first parts get the extra pennies).
stretch: Add operators `+` and `-` (milestone 7 shows how) and refuse negative results.
